description: This file contains utility functions for translating between HTTP/2 error codes and SPDY error codes, as well as converting connection and frame errors to strings, and a helper function for delta comparison. It is part of the HTTP/2 adapter implementation in the quiche project.

methods.name: ConnectionErrorToString
methods.description: Converts ConnectionError enum to string representation.

methods.name: InvalidFrameErrorToString
methods.description: Converts InvalidFrameError enum to string representation.

methods.name: DeltaAtLeastHalfLimit
methods.description: Checks if delta is at least half of the limit, considering only positive delta.
